author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
Autumn is the perfect time to gather bright red viburnum berries and prepare them for the colder months ahead 🍂🌾 In this video, we harvest fresh viburnum and turn the seasonal berries into homemade winter preserves and rustic baking.

The berries bring their distinctive tart flavor and beautiful color to the kitchen. Some are carefully prepared for preserving, while the rest are used in a warm homemade bake that feels perfect for a cool autumn day.

This is traditional seasonal village cooking — harvesting what nature provides, preserving part of it for winter, and enjoying the rest fresh. Viburnum berries add a special autumn character to simple homemade recipes and countryside baking. ❤️🍁🥧
title: Baking with Viburnum Berries | Harvest & Winter Preserves 🍂🌾
